subject: Pilot environment activation: greenlight playbook & MAP rhythm
messages:
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Torres <sam.torres@orchardhealth.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 23 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot environment activation: greenlight playbook & MAP rhythm

Hi Sam — good to connect earlier. Following up with a concise activation playbook so we can lock the pilot window and cadence. High-level asks for today: API key provisioning, org invite, IP allowlist, and VPC peering request. Neha will own engineering handoff; Vanessa will own post-activation success metrics.

Proposed 2-week activation runway (target greenlight):
- Day 0 (today): sign-off on MAP (attached RDW_MAP_v1.xlsx) and confirm procurement timeline
- Day 1–2: Org invite + API keys (ephemeral + service account) provisioned
- Day 3–5: IP allowlist testing against staging endpoints (sample CSV attached)
- Day 6–9: VPC peering request submitted and validated (form attached)
- Day 10–14: Burn-in run, latency checks, and close/Go-NoGo meeting

Sam — can you confirm the procurement ETA and whether your infra team can complete the VPC peering request form by EOD Thursday? If procurement needs anything from our SOW/quote side, loop procurement@orchardhealth.ai and we’ll push.

Neha — please note: we expect to create an org-level service account and an ephemeral developer key for the pilot UI. Keep the key TTL to 72 hours for staging. Also capture the ephemeral token rotation instructions in the MAP sheet.

Thanks — aiming to get the greenlight meeting on the calendar for 2026-07-07 if we hit targets.

— Markus
Markus Klein
Head of Field Engineering, Redwood Inference
markus.klein@redwood.ai

From: Sam Torres <sam.torres@orchardhealth.ai>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@orchardhealth.ai
Date: Tue, 23 Jun 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot environment activation: greenlight playbook & MAP rhythm

Thanks Markus — clear and appreciated. Procurement expects PO by next Tuesday (2026-06-30). I’ve copied procurement to confirm any contract redlines. On the infra side: I’ll get our network lead to complete the VPC peering form by Thursday morning. I’ve attached our current firewall block list; we’ll add the sample allowlist columns you sent.

A couple of notes:
- We prefer a single service account for the pilot, scoped to the pilot tenant.
- We can accept ephemeral keys but will need a short runbook on rotation and audit logging (can Neha drop the runbook into the MAP spreadsheet?).

If PO arrives by 06-30 and peering completes on Thursday, the 2-week runway looks doable.

— Sam
Sam Torres
Director, Platform Engineering — Orchard Health
sam.torres@orchardhealth.ai

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sam Torres <sam.torres@orchardhealth.ai>
Date: Wed, 24 Jun 2026 08:17:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot environment activation: greenlight playbook & MAP rhythm

Quick technical plan and owner roster — copying into thread so Orchard has a single source of truth: 

1) Org & API access (Owner: Neha)
- I will create the Orchard pilot org and invite Sam (org admin) and a service account.
- Service account will be limited to "pilot-tenant"; we’ll create one developer ephemeral key with 72h TTL for UI testing.
- Deliverable: API key + SCIM invite + short rotation runbook in MAP sheet.

2) IP allowlist (Owner: Orchard infra, validated by Neha)
- Sam to provide the final IP CIDR list; I’ll stage allowlist entries in staging and run a simple curl smoke test.
- Expected failure modes: NAT'd egress ranges — if you see an inconsistent IP, send the traceroute.

3) VPC peering (Owner: Orchard infra → Neha for validation)
- I’ll fill our side of the peering form and provide the firewall rules we need on your end.
- Once your network team returns the completed peering request, I’ll validate BGP/route tables and run a reachability check.

4) Cutover & burn-in (Owner: Vanessa)
- 48h burn-in with perf scripts (latency P95 target < 150ms for 1k qps synthetic).
- Vanessa will run the acceptance checklist and record token-level cost metrics to the console.

Attachments I uploaded to the MAP workbook: RDW_MAP_v1.xlsx (tab: owners), network_allowlist_sample.csv. 

I’ll run the initial org invite this morning and post the service account credentials (securely) once Orchard confirms the PO window.

— Neha
Neha Kapoor
Principal Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.ai

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Sam Torres <sam.torres@orchardhealth.ai>
Date: Thu, 25 Jun 2026 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot environment activation: greenlight playbook & MAP rhythm

Thanks team — this is the sync I wanted. Summary and final asks before I close the MAP: 
- Procurement: Sam/procurement to confirm PO by 2026-06-30. If procurement needs the SOW redline, Markus to provide a one-page amendment.
- Org/API: Neha to provision and post ephemeral key in secure channel by 2026-06-24 AM (in progress).
- IP allowlist: Sam to send final CIDRs by 2026-06-24 EOD. Neha will validate and run smoke test by 06-25.
- VPC peering: Orchard to return completed vpc_peering_request_form.pdf by 06-25 morning. Our network will validate and confirm peering by 06-28.

Decision point: If the above checkpoints are met, schedule Greenlight Review meeting for 2026-07-07 10:00 AM PT (tentative). If any checkpoint slips >48h we move the greenlight to 2026-07-14.

Action items (owner / due):
- PO confirmation (Sam / procurement) — 2026-06-30
- Final CIDR list (Sam) — 2026-06-24 EOD (received pending)
- Service account + ephemeral key (Neha) — 2026-06-24 AM (in progress)
- Peering form completion (Orchard Net) — 2026-06-25 AM
- Runbook & acceptance checklist (Vanessa) — 2026-06-30

Thanks everyone — please reply inline if dates need adjusting. I’ll update the RDW_MAP_v1.xlsx after we get the peering form.

— Markus
Markus Klein
Head of Field Engineering, Redwood Inference
